name: Mechmaster (Prestige Class)
body:
Not all mech pilots rely on psionic connections or akashic bonds to take control of their vessels. Mech masters learn to maneuver their mechs through a combination of mechanical know-how and sheer determination, utilizing their vessel as an extension of their own martial prowess.

Hit Die: d10.

Requirements

To qualify to become a mech master, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Feats: Vehicle Expert*.
Skills: Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks, Fly or Ride 5 ranks.
Class Skills

The mech master’s class skills (and the key ability for each skill) are Acrobatics (Dex), Craft (all) (Int), Fly (Dex), Knowledge (engineering) (Int), Perception (Wis), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).

Skill Points at each Level: 4 + Int modifier

Table: Mech master Class Features
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Class Features
1st	+0	+1	+1	+0	Bonded mech
2	+2	+1	+1	+1	Bonus feat
3	+3	+2	+2	+1	Divert Damage
Bonded Mech (Ex)

At 1st level, the mech master gains a bonded mech, treating his character level -3 as his pilot level.

This stacks with any pilot levels the mech master may have from other class levels, to a maximum of his character level.

Bonus Feat (Ex)

At 2nd level, the mech master gains a bonus feat from among feats that have the bonded mech class feature as prerequisites. The mech master must meet the prerequisites for this feat.

Divert Damage (Ex)

At 3rd level, when the mech master or their mech would take damage, the mech master may spend an immediate action to divert half the damage to the other target (either the mech master or their mech).

This damage ignores any hardness or damage reduction the target possesses.
